description: This file defines debugging and logging components for the FreeType project, including trace levels, macros for tracing, error handling, assertions, and function declarations related to debugging.

methods.name: FT_Trace_Get_Count
methods.description: Returns the number of available trace components, or 0 if debugging is not enabled.

methods.name: FT_Trace_Get_Name
methods.description: Returns the name of a trace component given its index.
